description: UCI row 7 (age 35, MEDIUM vulnerability, moderate knowledge, RT 4, horizon 3yr) — eu balanced fund: all hard rules pass, soft fails ['R3'] (score 85) -> SUITABLE
client_narrative: Lars Ericsson is 35 years old and works as a financial controller at a mid-sized company. He earns approximately 59,300 euros per year. He holds only 2,700 euros in accessible savings but wants to invest 8,900 euros for a 3-year horizon using funds from a maturing insurance policy. Lars has moderate investment knowledge: he understands diversification, asset allocation, and the risk-return trade-off, and has previously held balanced funds and bond funds. He rates his risk tolerance at 4 out of 10 and has stated he cannot afford to lose his investment. His investment objective is asset growth.
product_narrative: The product is a UCITS-registered European balanced fund that allocates between 40% and 60% to eurozone equities and the remainder to European investment-grade bonds, adjusting dynamically based on market conditions. The fund is actively managed, publishes a KID, and is classified as complex due to its use of interest rate futures for duration management. It requires moderate financial knowledge to evaluate. The minimum recommended holding period is four years. In adverse scenarios partial capital loss is possible.
